article.headline: Jon Mekonnen's double-double powers South Dakota State to 71-46 victory over Northern Colorado
article.description: — Jon Mekonnen totaled 14 points and 11 rebounds to lead South Dakota State to a 71-46 victory over Northern Colorado on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Jon Mekonnen's double-double powers South Dakota State to 71-46 victory over Northern Colorado

categories.description: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Northern Colorado Bears

event.description: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Northern Colorado Bears

keywords: South Dakota State Jackrabbits @ Northern Colorado Bears
article.story: RAPID CITY, S.D. -- — Jon Mekonnen totaled 14 points and 11 rebounds to lead South Dakota State to a 71-46 victory over Northern Colorado on Saturday night. EJ Ryans added 13 points for the Jackrabbits (4-0), while Joe Sayler scored 10 with six assists. Andrew Crawford had 16 points to lead the Bears (2-2), who trailed 28-17 at halftime. Hunter Caldwell added 13 points. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
